content:
rachel: heads-up — onboarding rwd-llm-v3-small (int8 quant) on dedicated for long-context evaluation. ran prefill + streaming regression tests, and seeing token-level divergence vs fp16 after ~68k tokens. not just perf, quality drops on a few prompt families. :thinking:

rachel: repro steps: mounted model on ded-gpu-03, ran `longctx_prefill_test.py --model rwd-llm-v3-small-int8 --prefill 70000 --zero-copy`. output diffs attached inline below.

devon: can you paste a short diff sample? also which quant backend (qlinear/int8-native)?

rachel: sample diff (trimmed):
```
--- fp16 baseline
@@ prompt id 42
... "The theorem follows from linearity."
+++ int8 run
@@ prompt id 42
... "So the claim holds by induction."
```

rachel: logs show repeated KV-cache shadowing warnings around token 68012:
```
[2026-03-10T14:12:31Z] kvcache: idx-mismatch detected at seq=68012 prefill-window=65536
[2026-03-10T14:12:31Z] kvcache: fallback to direct recompute
```

anya: :eyes: that idx-mismatch + the token count > 64k screams RoPE wrap/phase handling edge case. did we run with rotary scaling enabled or legacy RoPE?

rachel: rotary scaling=auto (default). quant backend is int8-native (perference set in model config).

sam: possible causes: 1) quantized kernel uses f32->int8 pack that truncates phase precision, 2) index math on KV buffer uses 32-bit modulo that behaves differently when prefill > buffer size, 3) or mismatch between streaming prefill path and full-prefill path for cache addresses.

devon: can you run a tiny repro that toggles rotary scaling and the prefill window? e.g. two runs: `--rope-mode legacy` and `--rope-mode scaled` and `--prefill 66000` vs `--prefill 70000`. tag me.

rachel: running now. kicking off 4 jobs:
```
longctx_prefill_test.py --model rwd-llm-v3-small-int8 --rope-mode scaled --prefill 66000 --out /tmp/runA
longctx_prefill_test.py --model rwd-llm-v3-small-int8 --rope-mode scaled --prefill 70000 --out /tmp/runB
longctx_prefill_test.py --model rwd-llm-v3-small-int8 --rope-mode legacy --prefill 66000 --out /tmp/runC
longctx_prefill_test.py --model rwd-llm-v3-small-int8 --rope-mode legacy --prefill 70000 --out /tmp/runD
```

infra-bot: test jobs queued: https://ci.internal/runs/rlm-1728765432-1 (runA), rl...-2 (runB), rl...-3 (runC), rl...-4 (runD) :white_check_mark:

ml-test-runner: quick summary (first two finished):
- runA (scaled, 66k): matches fp16 baseline on 99.6% tokens, no kvcache warnings.
- runB (scaled, 70k): divergence at 68012, kvcache idx-mismatch as rachel saw.

ml-test-runner: runC (legacy, 66k) shows small diffs at ~65000 but no idx-mismatch; runD (legacy, 70k) reproduces mismatch earlier ~65980.

anya: pattern: scaled mode tolerates slightly longer prefill before mismatch, legacy mode trips earlier. could be a bias in rope-phase computation between modes when quantized.

sam: next step: instrument rotary phase multiply in int8 kernels to log accumulator range and rounding counts. might be an int overflow/rounding accumulation error that propagates into attention and then into wrong KV indices.

rachel: added lightweight instrumentation to int8 rotary mul (push branch rachel/rotary-int8-logs). running small smoke to collect stats: `pytest -k rot_mul_int8 --max-seqs 1000`.

devon: also please run `kv-checker --dump-addr-map --min-prefill 65000 --max-prefill 70500` on those runs to confirm whether address translation changed. output format is CSV, paste head.

rachel: kv-checker head for runB:
```
addr_idx,seq,expected_kv_slot,observed_kv_slot
65534,65534,65534,65534
65535,65535,65535,65535
65536,65536,0,0
68011,68011,24675,24675
68012,68012,24676,24677  # mismatch here, off by +1 in observed slot
68013,68013,24677,24677
```

anya: observed slot +1 at the boundary — that points to an off-by-one in modulo when index crosses the buffer wrap. why only in int8 runs? maybe a fence missing or a typed truncation where signed vs unsigned cast differs for 64-bit->32-bit in quant path.

sam: good call. check the allocation size: if buffer_size variable is int32 in quantized kernels but int64 elsewhere, the modulus could wrap incorrectly after conversion. rachel can you print types in compiled kernel (we have debug build).

rachel: confirmed: in int8-native compiled kernels, `kv_ring_len` was cast to int32 for pack routine. patch incoming. will run full regression after patch.

ml-test-runner: patched build queued. expected to finish in ~45m. tagging this as P0 for model onboarding quality. :pray:

devon: thanks — once patched, please re-run runB and runD. if mismatch goes away, we ship a hotfix for the int8 runtime. otherwise we dig deeper into rope numeric error.

rachel: will update thread with final pass. thanks all. :thumbsup:
